points.name: settings.notification_center.focus_register
points.interpretation: The create and rebuild paths register callback 0x0c5683d9 for filter 7 with user data 0.

points.name: settings.notification_center.focus_data
points.interpretation: The callback enters its setting change path only when the retrieved data is 0; enabling also checks the wrist-related system state.

points.name: settings.notification_center.focus_hint
points.interpretation: Create and rebuild set focus_notify_tips.settings on the same stored hint label.

points.name: settings.control_center.toggle_register
points.interpretation: The list builder registers callback 0x0c551979 for filter 7; its handler changes persist.fusion_center_state.

points.name: settings.control_center.hint
points.interpretation: The list builder sets control_center_lable.settings on its description label.

evidence: The settings app registers the page descriptors. The notification-center create and rebuild paths register the same switch callback and set its hint; the callback uses event data 0 to enter the state-change branch. The control-center list builder registers a callback that writes persist.fusion_center_state and updates its switch state. Both page lifecycle destroy paths clear their corresponding state slots.
scope: Only the listed call sites while their respective settings pages are active. Other notification and control-center state changes are not intercepted.
limitations: Suppressing callbacks may leave UI and persistent state inconsistent. State checks are not thread barriers; shared-entry publication and rollback require system-wide quiescence. Device behavior remains unverified.
